title: Close remaining actionable code-scanning alerts
summary: Make response-header sanitization explicit, add Dependabot cooldowns, and replace avoidable dynamic-regex and partial-percent parsing patterns with bounded behavior.
reason: The final main scan retained one medium CodeQL alert because taint analysis did not recognize the canonical-origin allowlist, and Semgrep identified five missing Dependabot cooldowns plus four avoidable JavaScript audit patterns.
behavior_before: Canonical origins rejected CR/LF upstream but header construction did not visibly sanitize them to CodeQL; Dependabot version updates had no release-age cooldown; simple parsing/glob helpers used avoidable audit-query patterns.
behavior_after: Header construction and both final emission sinks remove CR/LF as defense in depth; all five version-update ecosystems wait seven days while security updates remain immediate; percent/count parsing avoids the flagged patterns; track-title globs use literal wildcard matching with backend-owned pattern/value limits mirrored fail-closed in the WebView.
